correctness.rationale: The nonnegative variational reduction is exact for both scalar fields. The summed weighted Young identity includes both correct endpoint penalties. Its ratio to squared increments of x^(p/2) is strictly positive, globally bounded, and has diagonal curvature c_p=2(p-1)/p². Sine recovery proves limsup≤c_pπ². Uniform comparison and both endpoint penalties yield Dirichlet H1 compactness; localized weak-lsc away from zeros, with vanishing gradient on the zero set, proves liminf≥c_pπ². Finite symbolic script checks a quartic identity but the analytical compactness proof, not finite experiments, establishes the limit.
